# Hire Me Now
> Canadian career coaching and resume strategy led by Julia Cher, Certified Resume Strategist. Serving newcomers, international students, career changers, and professionals across Canada.

## About
Hire Me Now is a Toronto-based career coaching service founded by Julia Cher, a Certified Resume Strategist with 15+ years of experience in employment services and private career coaching. The service helps job seekers who are not getting interviews understand what is blocking results, strengthen their positioning, and build a practical job search strategy aligned with how Canadian employers hire.

Multilingual support is available in English, Russian, Spanish, Hebrew, Cantonese, Bengali, Hindi, and Urdu.

## Services
- [Career Diagnostic — $149 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): One-time strategy session including resume and LinkedIn review, job search pattern analysis, and a clear 2–4 week action plan.
- [Resume Strategy Package — $349 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): One targeted resume, cover letter, LinkedIn positioning guidance, and application direction for one clear target role.
- [Multi-Path Career Strategy — $549 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): Two targeted resumes, two cover letters, interview preparation, offer evaluation guidance, and ongoing feedback for job seekers pursuing two directions or a career pivot.
- [LinkedIn Optimization — from $99 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): Standalone add-on to improve recruiter visibility and profile alignment.
- [Interview Preparation — from $99 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): Standalone add-on for answer preparation, delivery, and practice.
- [Labour Market Research — from $79 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): Identify realistic target roles and understand where your background fits in Canada.

## Who We Help
- Newcomers and internationally trained professionals translating experience for the Canadian market
- International students and new graduates entering the Canadian workforce
- Career changers building a clear story around transferable skills
- Professionals applying without results who need a focused strategy
- Students, teens, and families planning early career decisions

## Founder
Julia Cher is the founder and lead strategist at Hire Me Now. She holds the Certified Resume Strategist (CRS) credential awarded by the Professional Association of Resume Writers and Career Coaches (PARW/CC). She has over 15 years of experience helping job seekers compete in the Canadian labour market across industries and career levels.
